execution: Intent fixed after close; next listed session open plus adverse tick-rounded slippage; whole-lot all-or-reject, no terminal liquidation.
dividends: record-close, ex-before-open gross receivable, pay-after-trading; exact-rational forward total-return signal.
scope: One preselected liquid ETF; not a full-market stock selection backtest. Entry allocation is a reference budget, not a hard daily exposure cap. No leverage.
validation: Retrospective developmental comparison, not untouched holdout or live execution evidence. No automatic promotion or broker orders.
known_limitations: Daily open fills do not establish order-book availability or capacity
Costs are research assumptions, not Guoyuan account tariffs
Historical vendor revisions and publication latency are not fully point-in-time audited
Tax-free cash dividend accounting is an explicit research convention
